_about: One entry per study site. Every script in the canopy workflow reads this file, so adding a site here is all it takes to run the same analysis somewhere else. 'name' is what the page and tables show; 'boundary_name' is the name in the city's layer.
boundary_source: City of Tucson neighborhood associations, PublicMaps/NeighborhoodsPlans/MapServer/0 (NAME, STATUS, WARD only)
